# influxdb_variable (Resource)

Creates and manages a dashboard variable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    influxdb = {
      source = "thulasirajkomminar/influxdb"
    }
  }
}

provider "influxdb" {}

data "influxdb_organization" "iot" {
  name = "IoT"
}

resource "influxdb_variable" "deployment" {
  org_id      = data.influxdb_organization.iot.id
  name        = "deployment"
  description = "The deployment environments"
  arguments = jsonencode({
    type   = "constant"
    values = ["production", "staging", "development"]
  })
}

resource "influxdb_variable" "buckets" {
  org_id = data.influxdb_organization.iot.id
  name   = "buckets"
  arguments = jsonencode({
    type     = "query"
    language = "flux"
    query    = "buckets() |> keep(columns: [\"name\"])"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `arguments` (String) The variable arguments as a JSON object, e.g. `{"type": "constant", "values": ["a", "b"]}`. Must be valid JSON; this is validated at plan time.
- `name` (String) The variable name.
- `org_id` (String) The organization ID that owns the variable.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The variable description.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Variable creation date in RFC3339 format.
- `id` (String) The variable ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last variable update date in RFC3339 format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Variables can be imported by their ID.
terraform import influxdb_variable.deployment 0dfa2b8e6d2f0001
```
